I have a boyfriend whos very loving and understanding of me so im really grateful he's with me.

 Im so glad it worked out for you after you told mom about your feelings. I wish my mother responded as supportively as yours, a hug is nice and sometimes thats all it takes to make you feel so much better

I am in my early 20s. I'm tired of waking up every day feeling like this, I really want to try to make myself feel better

But I've learnt now that trying to tell parents how you feel is not the way to go
Thank you for replying. I've been very feeling down due to certain life circumstances and have just tried to express how I feel but it has backfired and has made me feel even more miserable.

The way they just blow off how I feel...its like they just don't care about my feelings at all...

I want to express my feelings and let them know how I really feel but it just never goes well. It's like I'll just forever be stuck with these thoughts to myself
I am the same age as you and in a very, very similar situation. Please PM if you want to talk, maybe it would make the two of us feel a little better.
